blocks.md: ***The preparation of lead(II)sulfate by precipitation from two soluble salts***

1. Measure out 25 cm<sup>3 </sup>of 0.5 mol dm<sup>-3 </sup>lead(II)nitrate solution and add it to a small beaker
2. Measure out 25 cm<sup>3 </sup>of 0.5 mol dm<sup>-3 </sup>of potassium sulfate add it to the beaker and mix together using a stirring rod
3. Filter to remove precipitate from mixture
4. Wash filtrate with distilled water to remove traces of other solutions
5. Leave in an oven to dry
**lead(II) nitrate + potassium sulfate → lead(II) sulfate + potassium nitrate**

blocks.md: Care should be taken with handling lead salts as they are toxic.
